propositions: The completion verifier returns non-deterministic verdicts (PASS vs FAIL with identical unmet criteria counts) on identical inputs (same ticket, code, acceptance criteria) across multiple runs within minutes with no intervening changes.
The verifier's false-negative failures on test-existence criteria block legitimate ticket closes and force retries; false-positive passes on identical input undermine attestation reliability.

The verifier's test-existence judgment relies on fallible free-form agent search queries (semantic/regex substrings) rather than deterministic ticket-id/symbol lookup and directory enumeration, causing search variance to flip conclusions between 'test exists' and 'test not found'.
The COMPLETION_VERDICT sidecar payload lacks recorded verify_at_sha, trace_id, and input context, preventing post-hoc diagnosis of non-determinism from stored data alone.
Temperature is left unpinned in the LLM call, allowing sampling variance to modulate agent query strategy and search behavior.
